programme.title: Wayil Islands, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: Wayil Islands are located northwest of Wayibatan Island. The wild labyrinth of lagoons among the craggy islets of Wayil in Misool is the definition of tranquillity. Also known as Wayil Batan islands, witness plenty of deserted beaches with spectacular scenery. Wayil Batan islands come from karst that was broken off from larger islands nearby.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Zapote, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Zapote is located 20 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. Cenote Zapote is named after the Sapote trees growing nearby. It is located on the “Ruta de los Cenotes” the old road from Puerto Morelos to Valladolid. Zapote has quite a deep drop from the land surface to the water surface of 6m/20ft but its access is easy via stairs. The walls will rise above you like a fortress and once you start your descent they become narrower until a depth of 20m/66ft before starting to open back up again. Once you reach a depth of 30m/100ft you will be above the talus cone in a bell shaped chamber with a narrow skylight in the top through which you just descended. Halocline and a thin misty layer of Hydrogen Sulfide floating on top of it, as well as some of the most amazing and incredible formations commonly described as bells, elephant feet, shower heads or trumpets will truly take your breath away with their strange beauty and impressive size.

programme.title: Dive Site Saporkren at Night, Raja Ampat, Indonesia
programme.desc: The village of Saporken is located on the island of Waigeo, close to the capital town of Waisai. This site is typically dived at night, however day diving is good too. Saporkren is your typical sandy bottom muck dive site, which is a little grubby since its just off of the village jetty. Making your way down a gentle slope (with little or no current) past a few coral bommies, the best bit of Saporkren is generally around 12-20 metres. We found full-size seahorses, cute bobtail squid, flying flatworms, clownfish anemones, colemani shrimp plus many unusual crabs species such as the boxer, xeno and porcelain.

programme.title: Padar island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Padar island is located in the middle of the straight between Rinca and Komodo Island. Padar is the third largest island in the Komodo National Park. It is located in the south central of the park, between Komodo and Rinca Island. In the past, Padar was one of the island in Komodo where there were dragons live. Along with the illegal hunting activities by human being, they are slowly disappeared and almost unable to see them anymore. The cause is simply because of the lack of foods, like deer and wild boar. Their extinction can be because they just died alone without any food to eat or prolonged hunger or they can be migrated to nearest island, Rinca. The island now remains empty with no dragons. However, other wild animals such as wild boars are still around daily. Today, Padar has become one of the most popular place to visit in Indonesia. It offers super magnificent view from the top of the island with pink sandy beach on the west side and white sandy beach on the east side. Formation of towering hill, just like Jurassic park. Although the island has no dragons existed, the island is one of the best charming spot of trekking. Those who love photographic, this is perhaps the best place for spectacular photos.

programme.title: Dive Site C56 Shipwreck, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: C-56 Shipwreck dive site is located in Puerto Morelos. The C-56 shipwreck served in World War II and it was sold to the Mexican Marine in 1966. The time pass by and later on 28th Oct 2000 was purposefully sunk, as a new attraction for divers coming to the Riviera Maya. Laying perfectly upright, with the keel on the sand at 90ft, the 184ft long Mexican Gun Boat was quickly inhabited by various marine life. The deck, at 64ft, is teeming with life and it's common to see a large shoal of Big Eye Travellies hunting there. As we travel around the wreck we commonly see large Wrasse, Groupers, Morays and, looking up, flights of Eagle Rays. Soft corals have colonized the wreck and now offer a home to many Arrow crabs and Fire worms amongst other small crustaceans and invertebrates.

programme.title: Sumidero Canyon, Tuxtla Gutiérrez , Mexico
programme.desc: Sumidero Canyon is located just north of the city of Tuxtla Gutiérrez. Sumidero Canyon (Spanish: Cañón del Sumidero) is a deep natural canyon which creation began around the same time as the Grand Canyon in the U.S. by a crack in the area's crust and subsequent erosion by the Grijalva River, which still runs through it. Sumidero Canyon has vertical walls which reach as high as 1,000 metres, with the river turning up to 90 degrees during the 13 kilometre length of the narrow passage.

programme.title: Wayag Island, Raja Ampat, Indonesia

programme.title: Dive Site Batu Bolong South, Komodo National Park, Indonesia Trailer
programme.desc: Embark on an amazing journey to explore the wonders of Batu Bolong south, a remote and enchanting diving location in Komodo National Park. Dive into crystal-clear waters with excellent visibility to encounter a vibrant array of marine life and stunning underwater landscapes. However, navigating the challenges of strong currents and varying depths requires careful preparation and diving experience. From the captivating giant trevally to the intricate social structures of anthias, you'll observe fascinating behaviors and adaptations of the underwater world's inhabitants. The documentary also sheds light on the unique coral reefs, their crucial symbiotic relationships, and the serious threats they face. This highlights the urgent need for conservation efforts to protect these vital underwater ecosystems often referred to as the "rainforests of the sea." Ultimately, this episode provides a captivating and educational glimpse into the incredible marine life and underscores the importance of preserving these precious underwater environments.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Dos Ojos, Tulum, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Dos Ojos is located 15 kilometers north of Tulum. Dos Ojos (Two Eyes) refers to two neighboring cenotes that are connected by a large cavern that also connects to a subterranean river. The original explorations of this water system, one of the largest in the world, started in the Dos Ojos cenotes. The total length of the combined system was measured at 310.95 kilometers (193.22 mi). This cenote dive site consists of two independent circuits: The first dive starts at the Barbie Line, a 415 meters line with wide spaces and large light galleries. The second dive circuit is called the Bat Cave, a very different experience. The Bat Cave is an adjacent cenote, next to Dos Ojos, and represents a much more preserved environment, mainly due the fact that the roof of the cenote hasn’t collapsed yet and all of the formations around it are in very good shape.

programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Besar, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Siaba Besar dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar dive site is a sheltered bay with coral seamounts and amazing coral reefs, located in the North-West side of the island. The reef is 4-6 meters deep with healthy corals and sand patches around. It has a massive coral garden and lacks strong currents, but it does not mean it lacks cool sights and marine life, just the opposite! This feature makes Siaba Besar a suitable dive site for any kind of level, being the best place for those who have never dived and want to try this amazing experience in Komodo National Park. Siaba Besar is heaven for snorkelers, given its easy conditions with shallow coral reefs, very little current and abundant marine life. A superlative snorkeling among sea turtles it is guaranteed, which gives the nickname to this site: Turtle City

programme.title: Dive Site Manta Point, Nusa Penida, Indonesia
programme.desc: In this episode, you will explore Manta Point, located in Nusa Penida, Bali, Indonesia, and learn about its remarkable marine inhabitants. Manta Point, situated on Nusa Penida's southwest coast, is renowned for its resident Manta ray colony, making it a must-visit dive site. Divers of all levels are drawn to its diverse range of underwater experiences, including reef exploration, photography, training, and fish identification. Notable species found here include the day octopus and the tawny nurse shark, both captivating creatures. Manta rays, particularly the Manta alfredi species, gracefully glide through the water with their distinctive pectoral fins and are often seen at cleaning stations, where cleaner fish help them rid parasites. However, these majestic creatures face threats from overfishing and human impacts. Manta Point offers an extraordinary underwater adventure, showcasing the beauty and diversity of marine life in this region.

programme.title: The Komodo dragons of south Rinca, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Horseshoe Bay is located in the south of Rinca island, it is formed by Rinca island in the north and Nusa Kode in the south. The area is well known to be one of the best place to see wild Komodo dragons. The Komodo dragon (Varanus komodoensis), also known as the Komodo monitor, is a member of the monitor lizard family Varanidae that is endemic to the Indonesian islands of Komodo, Rinca, Flores, and Gili Motang. It is the largest extant species of lizard, growing to a maximum length of 3 metres, and weighing up to approximately 70 kilograms. As a result of their size, Komodo dragons are apex predators, and dominate the ecosystems in which they live. Komodo dragons hunt and ambush prey including invertebrates, birds, and mammals. It has been claimed that they have a venomous bite; there are two glands in the lower jaw that secrete several toxic proteins. The biological significance of these proteins is disputed, but the glands have been shown to secrete an anticoagulant. Komodo dragons' group behavior in hunting is exceptional in the reptile world. The diet of Komodo dragons mainly consists of Javan rusa (Rusa timorensis), though they also eat considerable amounts of carrion. Komodo dragons also occasionally attack humans.

programme.title: Lawa Darat island, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Lawa Darat island is located in the northern part of the Komodo National Park. Also known as the “island close to the land” has a barren, desert savannah that changes color from green to yellow depending on the season. The island features easy hiking trails and two viewpoints to suit both spectacular sunrise and sunsets. Lawa Darat island is well protected from strong winds and waves, making the island the perfect spot for various activities to be carried out in safety. Some even refer to the island as the Komodo’s fjord, as attributed to its geological position. Besides, Lawa Darat island’s proximity to the ocean crossroads enables visitors to experience unexpected marine surprises such as encountering the humpback or the blue whale emerging majestically from the sea. The main attraction of Lawa Darat island is the scenic view that awaits visitors as they trek and reach the peak. This sole reason is what drives most Komodo National Park visitors to land on this island. Although beautiful all day long, the best recommended time to trek to the peak is sunset, when the breathtaking panoramic view calls for an Instagram selfie. The vantage point makes it perfect for capturing the beautiful beaches or the rolling hills catching rays of light. Trekking to the peak of the island might be considered as quite challenging for some, in particular, the beginners, but it is incredibly doable and worthwhile. The view is better and more beautiful as you trek higher where the reef becomes clearer while the mountainside begins to glow. Be ready for the remarkable panorama that awaits you at the top where the Komodo National Park lies in the opposite.

programme.title: Dive Site Manta Alley, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Manta Alley dive site is located at the far southern end of Komodo Island in the Indian Ocean. Manta Alley consists of a series of small rocky islands a few hundred meters away from the main island. There are several spots around these rocks where mantas can be found almost all year round. The site starts in a shallow reef close to the shore, where you can expect a strong to mild drift dive. You should keep your eyes wide open just as you enter the water, as mantas can be often found right in the shallows. Manta Rays are coming to this area for mating and cleaning purposes, where small wrasse and butterfly fish clean the mantas of parasites. The cleaning station is around 20 meters, where the rocks meet a white sandy bottom, perfect spot to watch mantas gliding into the rocks. Though mantas are the main attraction of this site, Manta Alley it is also full of marine life including reef sharks, schools of trevallies and large wrasses. The corals are very beautiful and diverse as well, making this spot a spectacular background for marine life photography.

programme.title: Dive Site Cenote Maravilla, Puerto Morelos, Mexico
programme.desc: Cenote Maravilla is located 10 kilometers west of Puerto Morelos. The cenote is a sinkhole in the shape of a bell, where the entrance is a hole in the middle of the top. The thick sulfur cloud offers views that look from another planet. Getting close to this cloud is necessary to observe the gorgeous living stalactites, the biothems often called “Hell’s bells.” Those mysterious rock formations are alive and grow underwater thanks to extraordinary endemic bacteria. This type of speleothems, called “elephant feet,” has been found in only 4 cenotes, all in the Puerto Morelos area and are subject to ongoing scientific research.

programme.title: Dive Site Siaba Kecil, Komodo National Park, Indonesia
programme.desc: Siaba Kecil dive site is located in the Central part of the Komodo National Park. The best time to dive this site is when the current is running! This is a real rollercoaster of a ride and will often be referred to as the 'Superman drift'. This gorgeous coral reef with a stunning overhang has a fast moving current - nothing scary just a great drift along. No need to kick! Towards the end of the dive site you drift towards and more sheltered area and the current eases off. Here you can relax (catch your breath!), and admire the stunning hard corals and thousands on anthias. This is also a great spot for seeing hawksbill turtles. The strong currents of this dive site attract large fish including giant trevally, barracuda, tuna, sharks and the odd ray too! The overhangs provide a fascinating topography and if the current allows they are great to explore and hunt for nurse sharks, bamboo sharks and other bizarre creatures.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

programme.title: Khan Palace
programme.desc: We show you one of the best heritage of cultural tourism, as known The Khan's Palace. In the Crimean heartland, the longest-lived of the Turkic khanates left an even more enduring landmark, The Khan's Palace; in other words, home to the Crimean Tatars. Raised in the 16th century, Khan’s Palace served as a palace for the representatives of the Giray dynasty. Located in the city of Bakhchisaray, the palace was the political, spiritual, and cultural epicenter of the Crimean Tatars. Above all, n the the Palace has the limestone mountains, pristine forest slopes, and orchards.Khan's Palace is a complex containing majestic mosques, menacing courtrooms, a hidden harem, a fountain of tears, and sorrowful tombs. The earliest dated construction in this ensemble bears the date of 1532, while the written records mention the Palace under 1539.The Palace stretches more than 50000 square meters and consists of 17 buildings and 9 courtyards. So,the overall architectural ambiance of the Palace is a careful amalgam of Middle Eastern and Crimean Tatar tradition. Moreover gardens and a life-giving, sustaining, and purifying supply of water is the focal point of the Palace’s design. The Big Khan Mosque is one of the oldest structures in the Palace, dating back to 1532, in short of the best heritage of cultural tourism. The Mosque is one of the largest in Crimea and bears the name of Sahib I Giray as its commissioner. The entry into the mosque is from a portal facing north. In addition, the mosque is made by Ottoman-designed. The roof, a narthex, and porticos are covering the main prayer hall. From the porticos, rise two minarets to the height of 28 meters.The minarets are octagonal and adorned with conical tops and finials. The lead and glass are decorating the minarets with imitation stones. The walls of the Mosque contain murals; depicting Quranic inscriptions and Islamic symbology. The calligraphic adeptness of these murals is phenomenal and bears a proud testimony to the skills of Persian artists. To sum up, the murals appear in green cartouches on the main façade of the Mosque and add to the charm of wood and plasterwork.

Nichee au cœur des rues animees et des ruelles du quartier musulman, l’eglise Sainte-Anne, la mieux conservee des eglises croisees de Jerusalem, se distingue par sa tranquillite. Elle se trouve dans une cour entouree d’arbres et d’arbustes.

Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

Le site est proche des sources perennes de la riviere Yarkon et fait desormais partie du parc national de Yarkon en Israel. Plus de 6 000 ans de villes successives se sont construites sur la colline surplombant les sources de la riviere Yarkon.

programme.title: Amor Musical
programme.desc: Todo inicia cuando son transferidos a la escuela Jung San que recibe auspicio por parte de una fundación millonaria y poderosa. Como es de esperarse, los días escolares en esta escuela se convierte en una lucha sin fin. Cada día enfrentan el gran abismo entre el rico y el pobre. Ante la cruda realidad, en lo único que pueden confiar es en su música. Tocar con sus amigos es la única cosa que los mantiene vivos, al mismo tiempo, Su música los hace brillar por encima de los demás. “Amor Musical” es un drama musical como nunca antes visto; al mejor estilo y creado para el sentimiento punk.

programme.title: El Gran Vuelo de Francia, Provenza Alpes Costa Azul
programme.desc: The Explorers le cuentan la historia de una región del sureste de Francia, rica en contrastes... La historia de una región imposible de resumir en una sola palabra, por la infinita variedad de sus paisajes y culturas. Es la región Sur, también conocida como Provenza-Alpes-Costa Azul... Una región con tres caras.

programme.title: Des Racines et des ailes - Passion Patrimoine
programme.sub-title: Sur les rives de la Garonne
programme.desc: Des Pyrenees espagnoles ou elle prend sa source, au vaste estuaire de la Gironde ou elle se jette, la Garonne parcourt plus de 600 kilometres a travers le Comminges, l'Agenais ou l'Entre-deux-Mers. Le fleuve evolue au cours de ce long voyage. L'apport de ses affluents, comme la Neste, l'Ariege, le Tarn et le Lot, modifie son visage. A bord d'un helicoptere, Didier Taillefer part en Espagne pour faire des photos aeriennes de l'une des principales sources du fleuve : le Trou du Toro. Ce site exceptionnel est situe au pied du massif de la Maladeta, ou la Garonne disparaît sous terre avant de reapparaître au Val d'Artan. Au coeur des Pyrenees, le fleuve donne naissance a un jardin de Cocagne : le Comminges. Dans le village de Huos, Remy Martin a amenage un verger-potager bio sur un ancien meandre.

programme.desc: Go Dok Mi es una editora de libros, bastante tímida, se niega a abandonar su apartamento o interactuar con la gente de su alrededor lo mayor posible. programme.title: Le Grand Inventaire de la Planète: Arctique Canadien
programme.desc: Le règne du blanc. Les membres de l'expédition The Explorers partent à la découverte de l'Arctique canadien, une région emblématique du bouleversement climatique qui touche notre planète. Pour être au plus près d'une civilisation et d'une nature en pleine mutation, pour témoigner de l'évolution de la vie sur ces terres glaciales, l'expédition a parcouru le Grand Nord Canadien, du printemps au début de l'hiver.

programme.title: Lost in the Living
programme.desc: Buzzing with lust for adventure, a musician from Dublin and his band move to Berlin. Oisin leaves behind the weight of losing his mother, and anger towards his absent father. Oisin meets Sabine, a pretty Berliner who shows him the city's secret places: cool parks, deserted subway stations, skinny dipping lakes in the countryside.

programme.title: Impostora
programme.desc: Nimfa, an ugly street vender, meets jeremy, a talented plastice surgeon, in a car accident. To compensate for what happened, jeremy offers to help Nimfa by giving her new face through surgery. In her desire to change her life and escape her situation, she willingly undergoes complete facial reconstruction. She later discovers that her face is copied from Rosette, a wealthy and married woman who happens to be jeremy's lover. Rosette wants to escape her life with her husband and their kids. Forced to accept her circumstance, Nimfa becomes an imposer so Rosette and Jeremy can get away with their affair.

programme.title: El Gran Inventario del Planeta: Honduras

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Verbrenner - Elektro
programme.desc: Der Verbrennungsmotor wird auf den Straßen Stück für Stück vom Elektromotor abgelöst. Dennoch sind Diesel und Benziner noch immer ein wichtiger Bestandteil der Mobilität. Doch wie steht es um die Effizienz der Verbrennungsmotoren? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 5 größten Effizienz-Irrtümer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Getriebeirrtümer
programme.desc: Getriebe sind aus Autos nicht wegzudenken: Doch es gibt viele Irrtümer zu Getrieben, egal ob Schalter oder Automatik. Alex klärt die wichtigsten Irrtümer

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Rekuperation
programme.desc: Was bringt Bremsenergie-Rückgewinnung wirklich? Um diese Frage zu beantworten, ist Alexander Bloch zur Silvretta Hochalpen-Straße gereist und hat den großen Test gemacht. Mit dabei: Der 761-PS-Sportler Porsche Taycan Turbo S und der kleine Fiat 500e. Die Ergebnisse sind überraschend!

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Gran Turismo 7
programme.desc: Gran Turismo ist eines der beliebtesten Rennspiele überhaupt. Alex zockt heute den siebten Teil: Mehr Strecken, mehr Autos und mehr reale Fahrphysik soll das Spiel für die Playstation 5 bieten

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Spinnt Mazda?
programme.desc: Warum entwickelt ein Automobilhersteller wie Mazda weiterhin neue und große Dieselmotoren? Dabei ist der Markt für dieselbetriebene Fahrzeuge stark rückläufig und die Motoren haben in Bezug auf Effizienz scheinbar ihre Entwicklungsgrenze erreicht. Alexander Bloch erklärt, warum die Situation deutlich komplexer ist, als sie auf den ersten Blick erscheint.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Rivian R1T
programme.desc: Das US-Start-Up Rivian versucht, im ersten Aufschlag einen Pick-Up auf die Straße zu bringen, der alles kann. Denn sie behaupten, dass er fährt wie ein Sportwagen und geländegängig ist wie ein Off-Roader. Ähnlich wie beim Tesla Cybertruck, bietet der Rivian unglaubliche Fahrdaten. 835 PS, 1.231 Newtonmeter Drehmoment und von 0 auf 100 in 3 Sekunden.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - WLTP bei E-Autos
programme.desc: Mit dem WLTP-Verbrauch sollte alles besser werden: Endlich realistische Angaben zum Verbrauch eines Fahrzeugs und keine geschönten Mini-Verbräuche. Doch ist das wirklich so? WLTP ist vor allem für Verbrenner optimiert worden, für Elektro-Autos ist das Verfahren aus verschiedenen Gründen unbrauchbar. Die fünf größten WLTP-Fehler im Zusammenhang mit E-Autos hat Alex im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW M4 CSL
programme.desc: Ja, Alex findet die Optik des BMW M4 CSL tatsächlich Wow! Was ihn sonst noch am sportlichen Coupé begeistert, und was nicht so, erfahrt ihr im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Honda Civic Type R
programme.desc: Messgerät rein und Abfahrt: Alex kann seine Begeisterung für die Handschaltung und den drehfreudigen Turbo-Motor des Honda Civic Type R nicht verbergen. Ist er "nur" emotional oder performt er auch gut? Kleiner Spoiler: Bei der Bremsmessung gibt's eine Riesen-Überraschung!

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der Renault R5 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der Renault 5 feiert sein Comeback: Als elektrischer Kleinwagen im Retro-Design. Doch Optik ist nicht alles. Alexander Bloch prüft im E-Auto-Supertest, was der neue R5 bei Technik, Komfort und Platzangebot drauf hat. Auch Verbrauch, Reichweite und Dynamik stehen im Fokus. Ist der Renault 5 zurecht zum Auto des Jahres 2025 gewählt worden?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Top oder Flop? Der VW ID.7 im E-Auto-Supertest
programme.desc: Der ID.7 stellt die vierte Stufe der Elektromobilität bei VW dar. Die Fünf-Meter-Limo kommt mit einem neuen Elektromotor, neuen Features und Software und einer verbesserten Aerodynamik daher. Ob der ID.7 das beste Elektroauto unter 100.000 Euro im Supertest werden kann und damit den BWW i4 eDrive 40 entthront, prüft Alex im E-Auto Supertest.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Ford Explorer im Supertest – Wie gut ist er wirklich?
programme.desc: Der neue Ford Explorer mit 77 kWh Akku und Heckantrieb steht im Elektroauto-Supertest! Wie schlägt er sich in Effizienz, Qualität, Dynamik und Komfort? Ist er eine echte Alternative zu VW? Alex Bloch nimmt ihn genau unter die Lupe. Jetzt anschauen!

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - BMW i5: Deutschland kann es doch!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch bittet den BMW i5 eDrive40 zu einem ersten Check. Im ersten rein elektrischen 5er BMW sorgt der gleiche Elektromotor wie im BMW i4 eDrive40 für Vortrieb. Nun hat die E-Maschine mit mehr Gewicht zu kämpfen. Wie sich das auf die Reichweite und den Verbrauch auswirkt, ermittelt Bloch vor laufender Kamera. Dank Hands-Free-Driving geht das auch ohne Hände am Steuer.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Autonomes Fahren - Blick in die Zukunft mit autoELF
programme.desc: Die autoELF entstand im Projekt UNICARagil - ein autonomes Fahrzeug gemäß Level 4. Um autonom fahren zu können, braucht es viele verschiedene Sensoren - und die sind teuer. Alex Bloch lässt sich mit verschiedenen Manövern über die Teststrecke chauffieren und bespricht im Interview mit Prof. Dr.-Ing. Steven Peters die autonome Zukunft.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Die 5 Todsünden auf den ersten 1.000 km
programme.desc: Man hat lange gewartet und endlich ist es soweit: der Neuwagen ist da! Am liebsten würde man jetzt sofort ordentlich Gas geben. Aber Moment mal, war da nicht irgendwas? So ein neues Auto muss doch erst eingefahren werden, oder? Alexander Bloch erklärt, was auf den ersten 1.000 Kilometern zu beachten ist: Motor, Turbo, Bremsen, Dämpfer, Reifen - es gibt eine Menge zu tun.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - E-Auto-Highlights 2024: Auch ohne Förderung ein gutes Jahr
programme.desc: Auch 2024 kürt Alex Bloch wieder seine E-Auto-Highlights. Hier seht ihr die Top-Neuheiten: Günstig, schnell, viel Platz oder Offroad-tauglich. Hier ist für jeden etwas dabei!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Straße weiß, Akku leer? 4 E-Auto Winter-Mythen
programme.desc: Wenn es draußen frostig und kalt ist, kommt man mit dem E-Auto nur noch halb soweit und auch das Aufladen dauert doppelt so lang. Ist das wirklich so? Eisbär Alexander Bloch räumt mit den 4 gängigsten Winter-Mythen zu E-Autos auf.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - MG Marvel R
programme.desc: Mit dem MG Marvel R kommt das erste chinesische Elektro-Auto zum Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Kann er den arrivierten Herstellern aus Südkorea, Amerika und Deutschland die Stirn bieten? Alex findet es heraus.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Genesis GV60
programme.desc: Genesis ist die Luxus-Tochter von Kia und Hyundai. Auf der gleichen Plattform wie KIA EV6 und Hyundai Ioniq5 kommt der Genesis mit 435 PS Leistung und soll in nur 4 Sekunden auf 100 km/h beschleunigen.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - BMW i4 40 iDrive
programme.desc: BMW stellt mit dem BMW i4 eDrive40 ein E-Auto auf einer Verbrennerplattform auf die Straße. Wie gut das funktionieren kann, testet Alexander Bloch. Denn die Konkurrenz Tesla Model 3 Long Range, der Genesis GV 60 oder der Hyundai Ioniq 5 haben im E-Auto-Supertest bereits ordentlich vorgelegt.

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Mercedes-Benz EQS450
programme.desc: Heute im E-Auto Supertest mit Alexander Bloch - der Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+. Der Schwabe rühmt sich das beste E-Auto der Welt zu sein. Aber stimmt das wirklich? Reicht eine theoretische Reichweite von bis zu 780 Kilometern aus, um ein gutes E-Auto zu sein? Alexander Bloch jagt den Elektro-Stern durch den Supertest und findet heraus wie gut der EQS wirklich ist.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Audi Q4 50 e-tron
programme.desc: Auf dem MEB des Volkswagen-Konzerns entstehen zahlreiche E-Autos. Auch Audi nutzt die Plattform für den Q4 50 e-tron. Ist er damit nur ein teurer VW mit vier Ringen oder doch ein waschechter Audi? Alexander Bloch nimmt das Elektro-SUV genau unter die Lupe: Wie ist die Qualität? Wie gut ist die Bedienung? Welcher Verbrauch und welche Reichweite sind drin? Lädt der Audi Q4 50 e-tron wirklich schnell? Die Antworten gibt es im E-Auto-Supertest. Das wird gut!

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Der Fiat 500 Elektro
programme.desc: Fiat hat kräftig an seinem Kult-Mini - dem 500 - gefeilt. Die neue Generation kommt als vollelektrischer Kleinstwagen. Altbekanntes Design mit komplett neuer E-Technik. Kann der Italiener mit der Konkurrenz mithalten? Heute stellt sich der Fiat 500 Elektro dem E-Auto Supertest von Alexander Bloch. Wie gut lädt er? Wie groß ist die Reichweite? Wie sind Qualität und E-Auto-Ausstattung? Und vor allem: Wo findet er sich im Gesamt-Ranking wieder?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Doppelkupplungsgetriebe
programme.desc: Das Doppelkupplungsgetriebe hat in vielen Modellen die klassische Wandler-Automatik abgelöst. Größter Vorteil: nahezu keine Zugkraftunterbrechung. Doch die Technik ist nicht unumstritten - gerade in Bezug auf Komfort und Haltbarkeit. Alexander Bloch erklärt die 6 größten Irrtümer zum Doppelkupplungsgetriebe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Motor-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Egal ob Benziner, Diesel oder Elektro: Ohne Motor geht nichts. Dabei gibt es rund um die Motorentechnik viele Stammtischweisheiten: z.B. Hubraum ist durch nichts zu ersetzen. Aber ist das wirklich so? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 10 größten Irrtümer zu Downsizing, Turbo und Co.

programme.title: Icetastrophe
programme.desc: Un meteorite entra nell'atmosfera terrestre e si spezza a metà. Un pezzo colpisce il centro di Lennox, negli Stati Uniti, e subito dopo l'area circostante inizia a congelarsi; l'altro ha creato una nuova zona tropicale. L' umanità potrebbe salvarsi solo con il ricongiungimento delle due metà.

programme.title: 100 Gradi Sottozero - Trappola Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Un fan ossessionato e sua madre rapiscono delle ex "reginette dell'urlo" e le costringono a rimettere in scena i loro famosi ruoli cinematografici... con risultati letali.

programme.title: Ice Sharks
programme.desc: Una nuova razza di squali famelici e aggressivi emerge dai ghiacci di una stazione di ricerca in Antartide, divorando tutti coloro che incontrano sul loro percorso. Per i sopravvissuti della stazione, che sta sprofondando nelle acque gelide, inizierà una lotta per la vita.

programme.title: Age Of Ice
programme.desc: Una serie di terremoti improvvisi e violenti scuote la placca tettonica, provocando tempeste e abbassando di colpo le temperature su tutto il pianeta. Nel tentativo di mettersi in salvo, la famiglia Jones, in vacanza in Egitto, dovrà resistere alle gelide temperature che segnano l'inizio di una nuova era glaciale in grado di ricoprire di neve la Sfinge, le Piramidi e il deserto del Sahara.

programme.title: Airplane Vs. Volcano
programme.desc: Un aereo di linea rimane intrappolato all'interno di un anello di vulcani in eruzione. I passeggeri e l'equipaggio devono trovare un modo per sopravvivere ad alta quota, senza atterrare. Quando, però, la lava e le ceneri scatenano paura e sfiducia tra tutti, non sono solo i vulcani a essere pericolosi. Tutti devono imparare a collaborare se vogliono sopravvivere a questo epico volo di fuoco.

programme.title: Night Of The Wild
programme.desc: In una città apparentemente tranquilla, un meteorite produce un effetto pericoloso sui cani che si trasformano in assassini feroci. Con gli abitanti costretti a difendersi da quelli che un tempo erano gli amici più fedeli, la giovane Roslyn si ritrova a cercare un modo per sopravvivere. Cosa faresti al suo posto?

programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Un Natale Di Ghiaccio
programme.desc: Action movie ambientato tra i ghiacci dell’Alaska con Brendan Fehr e Jodelle Ferland. Siamo alla Vigilia di Natale e l’idillio delle feste viene bruscamente interrotto quando i ghiacciai, sciogliendosi, iniziano a rilasciare grandi quantità di metano liquido che, se non fermato, rischia di far esplodere l'intero pianeta.

programme.title: Icetastrophe

Un pezzo colpisce il centro di Lennox, negli Stati Uniti, e subito dopo l'area circostante inizia a congelarsi; l'altro ha creato una nuova zona tropicale. programme.title: Alien Siege
programme.desc: Dopo che un'astronave ha distrutto Washington, D.C., i residenti di una piccola città devono combattere un'unità di soldati alieni che danno la caccia al Presidente degli Stati Uniti e al misterioso dispositivo che sta trasportando, dopo che l'elicottero con cui stava fuggendo atterra proprio nelle vicinanze di quella cittadina.

programme.title: Bestie Dall'abisso - Il Giorno Del Giudizio
programme.desc: 15 anni prima le creature demoniache provenienti dal sottosuolo invasero la Terra con l'obiettivo di eliminare completamente il genere umano. Ricordato come il Giorno del Giudizio dai sopravvissuti di quell'infernale olocausto, l'umanità riuscì a prevalere. Le creature ora son tornate. Una famiglia cerca di difendersi e di richiudere l'ingresso che permette ai mostri di raggiungere il pianeta.

programme.title: 2012: Il Giorno Del Giudizio
programme.desc: 21 dicembre 2012. Quattro stranieri in viaggio si ritrovano ai piedi di un antico tempio inesplorato nel cuore del Messico. Per i Maya è l'ultimo giorno del calendario, per gli scienziati della Nasa è una catastrofica inversione dei poli magnetici della terra. Per l'umanità è il giorno del giudizio. L'apocalisse è vicina.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age - Una Nuova Era Glaciale
programme.desc: Un'eruzione vulcanica in Islanda provoca un progressivo congelamento di tutto il Nord America. Un padre di famiglia lotta per sfuggire all'assalto della glaciazione in arrivo che potrebbe estinguere l'intera umanità. I raggi solari non passano, la Terra sta entrando in una nuova Era Glaciale.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.2
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He continues his journey through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He meets the Lhoba people, China’s smallest ethnic group, who show him their traditional hunting attire. At a sacred lake, Tianran visits an ancient monastery and witnesses the 3000-year-old dance of the Gongbo Tibetans, before venturing to a remote village to experience their their way of life.

programme.title: The Art of Harmony: Inseparability of Things
programme.desc: “The Art of Harmony” is a documentary about Confucianism, produced by CGTN and Discovery Channel. It highlights the timeless nature of the sage’s philosophy and its global relevance today. Join us in exploring how the world might benefit from the pursuit of “The Art of Harmony”.

programme.title: Nyingchi Ep.3
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He rounds off his travels through Nyingchi, Xizang Autonomous Region. He journeys into the Yarlung Zangbo Grand Canyon – one of the largest and deepest canyons on Earth, and along the way, tries to catch a glimpse of Mount Namcha Barwa, the easternmost peak of the Himalayas. Instead, he encounters a waterfall said to be a gateway to the afterlife, before finally arriving at the entrance to the canyon.

programme.title: Wenzhou
programme.desc: Tianran He is in Wenzhou, southeast China — a city famed for its self-made millionaires. Here he meets the first Chinese shoemaker to expand overseas, and hears the stories of other local entrepreneurs. Along the way, he samples traditional snacks, visits some of China’s oldest lighthouses, and enjoys an evening of Ou Opera. He also learns the craft of papermaking, before heading into the hills to soak in hot springs and wander across ancient covered bridges.

programme.title: Outkirts of Wenzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He explores Wenzhou’s counties. From geological wonders and daring cliffside stunts at the Yandang Mountains, to rafting along the scenic Nanxi River, to harvesting seaweed and shellfish on the mud flats of the Dongtou Islands, Tianran discovers the ingenious ways the people of Wenzhou have transformed the challenges of living between mountains and seas into their greatest strengths.

programme.title: Dreams beyond the acrobatic stage
programme.desc: Many young acrobats from across China have gathered in Wuqiao, Cangzhou in north China's Hebei Province, with one shared goal: to dazzle audiences with their talents and stunt skills. They usually starts to train at an early age, shouldering the hopes and support of their families and teachers to become successful performers. We followed three of these young performers to show you how incredibly talented they are.

programme.title: Echoes of Green
programme.desc: Echoes of Green takes viewers deep into Anji’s bamboo forests and mountain villages, where a new generation of Chinese youth is redefining how to live with nature. Through stories of outdoor sports, forest cafés, tea rituals, and family farms, the series shows how ecological ideals have become everyday choices and creative lifestyles. It is not just about landscapes, but about people — young dreamers proving that prosperity and nature can grow side by side, and that culture gives life to sustainability.

programme.title: Quyang Stone Carving
programme.desc: Quyang is known as a hometown of Chinese carving. Quyang's stone carving works are popular around different parts of China, thus also exported to over 100 countries and regions worldwide. The style of Quyang stone carving both carries the mysterious and rough spirit of the Wei Dynasty and the natural and graceful forms of the Tang and Song dynasties. It reflects the life experiences and live philosophies of local artisans. Each statue's showcases unique oriental aesthetics.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below complex, large-scale looms. Using materials such as silk floss, gold thread, and peacock feather threads, they create luxurious fabrics like imperial dragon robes. To this day, Yunjin Brocade continues to be used in crafting high-end clothing and souvenirs. Creating Yunjin Brocade involves over 120 intricate and sophisticated processes before the final masterpiece takes shape. Having traversed over a millennium, its majestic and luxurious aura remains unchanged. Just like the Qinhuai River, which has flowed through Nanjing for over 3,000 years—clear and steadfast—its gentle currents cut through the annals of history as it journeys toward an even more distant future.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Ancient Ru Kiln embraces its new era
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: A Vibe of the Village: The Beat of Xiangxi Drums
programme.desc: Experience the vibrant power of Xiangxi Drum Dance. This program delves into the heart of Tujia and Miao cultures, showcasing the rhythmic beats and spirited performances that have echoed through West Hunan's mountains for centuries. Discover the stories, traditions, and raw energy of this captivating folk art.

programme.title: Kesi
programme.desc: Silk is a classic symbol of Chinese culture. It helped opened up economic and cultural exchanges between East and West and witnessed the spread of Eastern civilization to the world. As a representative of traditional Chinese silk art, kesi is renowned for its highly ornamental weaving techniques of highlighting warps and breaking wefts, and has been deeply loved by people for thousands of years. In folk culture, it enjoys the reputation of “an inch of kesi is worth an inch of gold.”

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Colored stone inlay art: Transformation matters
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

programme.title: Awakening Lion
programme.desc: Xingshi, or literally “awakened lion,” is a name for the southern style of the lion dance. Historically, it evolved from a court dance in the Tang Dynasty almost 1,200 years ago. With the southward migration of the population from the central plains, lion dance culture was introduced to the south. In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing
programme.desc: From the local delicacies of Beijing's Ox Street to latest hangouts and contemporary cuisine of the Chinese capital, hosts Tianran He and Eva May will give you a true taste of Beijing, and the fascinating stories and people behind them.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Foodwise: Beijing's Hutongs
programme.desc: The Hutongs in Beijing are considered the city's blood vessels, as these traditional alleyways make up the DNA of the capital for its rich history and culture. In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May zigzag their way through the Hutongs and the Forbidden City for a mouth-watering experience full of ancient and modern delicacies. Starring German designer Katrin, Russian artist Liuba and photographer Feng Yu from Beijing, our hosts are taking you along a journey that features fried noodles, dim sum, pancakes and co.!

programme.title: Foodwise: Changsha
programme.desc: In this episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May embark on a journey to Changsha in Hunan Province.?They taste their way through the local cuisine, discover the city's latest art and fashion trends, and find out why this place is one of China's "influencer hotspots", attracting millions of domestic and foreign tourists each year.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: Kung fu journey up Wudang Mountains
programme.desc: Located in central China's Hubei Province, Wudang Mountains is a UNESCO World Natural and Cultural Heritage site recognized as the cradle of Wudang kung fu and as a renowned Taoist sanctuary. Every year, young students from different parts of China flock to these well-established kung fu academies to experience a childhood like no other. Li Weimu and Li Muzi study at two separate kung fu academies, and are following their own paths at Wudang Mountains.

programme.title: Diabolo
programme.desc: In China, the diabolo has a history of over 600 years. From the earliest uniaxial design, it developed to have a double axis. With time, it came to be made in various shapes and from various materials. And its popularity began to spread around the world. In the hands of an expert, a diabolo can create a truly mesmerizing spectacle. So, let’s hear from a professional about the various tricks of his trade.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: Huayin Old Tunes: the Earliest Rock and Roll by the Yellow River
programme.desc: Huayin Laoqiang is the name given to a traditional form of shadow puppet show. It translates as “Huayin Old Tunes,” and originated in the chanting of the boatmen working at the confluence of the Yellow, Weihe, and Luohe Rivers, close to the city of Huayin in Shaanxi Province. This chanting evolved into folk songs which, with time, were illustrated with puppet shows. The loud music, rustic instruments, and enthusiastic performances epitomize the way the local people lead their lives.

programme.title: CULTURAL INHERITORS Colored stone inlay art: Transformation matters
programme.desc: The Vibe production team's meticulously crafted documentary series "Cultural Inheritors". The eight episodes span across various regions of China, focusing on the inheritors and artists of intangible cultural heritage. They explore and innovate with artisanal dedication, showcasing the extraordinary craftsmanship of fields such as the Ru Kiln porcelain, colored stone inlay, Pu'er tea, and Lingnan woodwork. Let’s embark on a cultural journey together, savoring the beauty of tradition and embracing the spirit of intangible cultural heritage!

programme.title: The Story of Flying Trident
programme.desc: Feicha, or a flying trident, is a type of performance where you balance a revolving trident on your body. In Chinese history, the trident was one of the 18 main weapons of war, but now it has become more of an acrobatic act. For thousands of years, people in China have practiced it as a performance and also as a way to keep fit. It seems like the trident is stuck to the person’s body like a magnet, but that effect is achieved by tensing and relaxing muscles at the right time so that the movement of the trident is channeled in the right direction—be it around the hands, neck, or back. Otherwise, its energy will turn against the performer.

In the Ming Dynasty around 400 years ago, xingshi appeared in Guangdong and was then widely spread throughout southern China and even overseas. Lion dance has become a very important part of Chinese culture.

Ne sachant pas de quoi il s'agit, les ouvriers déclenchent accidentellement le mécanisme et déclenchent une série d'événements qui pourraient bien mettre fin au monde tel que nous le connaissons.

programme.title: Special ID
programme.desc: Chan Chi-Lung est infiltré depuis des années dans le gang triadique hongkongais de Cheung Mo-Hung. Suite à l'échec d'une récente négociation menée par Lung avec les trois autres triades locales pour le compte de Hung, ce dernier commence à douter de son identité. Hung entreprend alors d'éliminer tous les policiers infiltrés de son gang, et nombre d'entre eux sont capturés et tués. Pressentant le danger, Lung demande à son capitaine, Cheung, de mettre fin à sa mission d'infiltration. Cependant, Cheung l'envoie en Chine continentale pour infiltrer un trafic de personnalités protégées . Ce trafic est dirigé par Sunny, le protégé de Hung et ancien camarade de Lung au sein du gang. Cheung promet de rétablir l'identité policière de Lung à la fin de la mission, une fois le trafic de Sunny ruiné. Lung accepte, accompagné de l'inspectrice Fang Jing et de son supérieur, Lei Peng, de la police chinoise. Mais avant qu'ils ne puissent atteindre Sunny, cette dernière disparaît soudainement, laissant Lung sans défense et en grand danger.

programme.desc: Encarcelado por unos asesinatos que no cometió, Randy escapa sólo para tropezar con la guarida de los verdaderos asesinos.

programme.title: On l'appelle Trinita
programme.desc: Un tireur paresseux et peu orthodoxe et son frère corpulent et voleur de chevaux défendent une colonie mormone contre un major accapareur de terres, un bandit mexicain et leurs hommes de main.

programme.title: On continue à l'appeller Trinita
programme.desc: Bambino essaie d'apprendre à son frère Trinity comment devenir un hors-la-loi, mais ils finissent par sauver une famille de pionniers et à défaire un réseau de contrebande.

programme.title: Furie au Missouri
programme.desc: Pendant les derniers mois de la guerre de Sécession, le frère de Joe est injustement tué par Clifford, un capitaine de l'armée nordiste. Joe décide de rejoindre un groupe de Sudistes déterminés à résister jusqu'au bout.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: L'inspecteur Leduque vient de la Nouvelle-Orléans à Virginia City pour reprendre Ben Cartwright pour un meurtre vieux de 20 ans. Lorsque Ben déclare publiquement qu'il se retire de la course au poste de gouverneur, les habitants de la ville sont bouleversés, non seulement à cause de cela, mais aussi parce que Little Joe a été accusé d'avoir abattu ...

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: À Tombstone, un nouveau shérif s'engage à débarrasser la ville des hors-la-loi tels que les frères O'Hara, avec l'aide d'un étrange avocat qui se promène toujours avec deux gros ouvrages de droit sous le bras.

programme.title: Un bounty killer à Trinita
programme.desc: Les habitants de Trinity décident d'engager un chasseur de primes notoire pour les protéger d'une bande de hors-la-loi mexicains qui sème la terreur dans la région. Il découvre que le véritable instigateur de ces bandits se cache en ville. Une fusillade sanglante met fin à l'emprise de la bande et rend le contrôle de la ville à ses habitants.

programme.title: Le rescapé de la vallée de la mort
programme.desc: Une bande d'anciens confédérés assiège un fort de la cavalerie.

programme.title: Adios Gringo
programme.desc: Un cow-boy tente de laver son nom en chassant les voleurs de bétail qui l'ont piégé en lui faisant acheter du bétail volé et qui sont également responsables du viol d'une jeune femme qu'il aide à se rétablir.

programme.title: Vengeance aux deux visages
programme.desc: Après avoir braqué une banque mexicaine, Dad Longworth s'empare du butin et laisse son complice Rio se faire capturer, mais Rio s'échappe et part à la recherche de Dad en Californie.

programme.title: Macho Callaghan se déchaîne
programme.desc: Un tireur solitaire traque les membres d'un gang de hors-la-loi qui a tué ses amis.

programme.title: Le clan des McMasters
programme.desc: Après la guerre de Sécession, un soldat noir retourne au ranch de son ancien patron. Tous les deux décident de travailler et de partager le fruit de leurs labeurs. Mais le voisinage n'est pas d'accord sur cette association.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: Django Kill... Tire encore si tu peux
programme.desc: Diverses factions, dont un bandit métis, une bande de cow-boys homosexuels et un prêtre, se disputent l'or volé dans une ville surréaliste.

programme.title: Les Impitoyables
programme.desc: Un prêtre et son frère jumeau se relaient pour défendre une petite ville contre le gang vicieux des Clayton.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este espisodio nos visitó Liz Guarneros, experta en empleabilidad y desarrollo profesional, sobre las claves para destacar en el mundo laboral actual. Desde consejos para construir un currículum efectivo hasta estrategias para causar una buena impresión en entrevistas, Liz comparte herramientas prácticas que ayudan a mejorar la presencia profesional en un mercado altamente competitivo. La charla aborda temas fundamentales como la importancia de tener una red laboral sólida, la relevancia de las habilidades blandas, el impacto del lenguaje corporal y cómo la inteligencia artificial ya forma parte del proceso de reclutamiento. Además, Liz desmitifica aspectos comunes como el uso de la foto en el CV, el rol de las palabras clave para superar filtros automatizados, y cómo adaptar el discurso al perfil de cada empresa. Con un estilo claro y directo, Liz ofrece tips precisos que van desde el diseño del currículum hasta cómo prepararse mentalmente para una entrevista. Este episodio es una guía esencial para quienes buscan empleo o quieren crecer profesionalmente en un entorno donde conectar, comunicar y presentarse bien marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: Conversamos con Fernanda de la Colina, especialista en educación financiera y cofundadora de Zumma, sobre los pilares fundamentales para tener unas finanzas personales sanas, realistas y sostenibles. Con un enfoque accesible y práctico, Fernanda explica conceptos clave como el interés compuesto, el manejo del crédito, las deudas buenas y malas, y la importancia de invertir desde edades tempranas. A través de respuestas rápidas, cápsulas informativas y consejos claros, este episodio busca desmitificar el mundo financiero y empoderar a las personas para tomar mejores decisiones con su dinero. Este episodio es una guía útil para quienes quieren comenzar a organizar sus finanzas, ahorrar con propósito o entender cómo y por qué invertir, todo desde una mirada fresca, joven y fundamentada.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Sergio Gutiérrez, actor, guionista y director independiente, sobre sus inicios en la actuación, su pasión por los escenarios y el proceso de construir personajes completos. Con una trayectoria que incluye participaciones en series de televisión, streaming y teatro, Sergio comparte anécdotas de sets masivos, entrenamientos con dobles de riesgo y su paso por producciones como míticas. Reflexionamos sobre la importancia de no juzgar a sus propios personajes, la presencia total en escena, y el valor del capital humano en tiempos de inteligencia artificial. Una charla auténtica y dinámica que revela lo que significa vivir la actuación desde todas sus trincheras.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficción
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion - La Entrevista de 24 Ficcion
programme.desc: Conversamos con Manu Calderón, actor, director y guionista. Compartió espisodios importantes sobre su trayectoria, que abarca desde teatro y comedia, hasta cine y series biográficas. Manu comparte sus inicios, las influencias que marcaron su carrera, como Pedro Infante, y anécdotas de casting tan inusuales como interpretar un plátano. Hablamos del compromiso que conllevan los personajes de soporte, de cómo abordar figuras icónicas sin perder la autenticidad y de la importancia de un buen casting en series basadas en hechos reales. También reflexionamos sobre la vulnerabilidad del actor, la capacidad de cambiar entre géneros y lo que no se ve detrás de un set. Una charla cercana y divertida que muestra el oficio actoral desde la pasión y la entrega absoluta.

programme.title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.sub-title: La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle - La Entrevista de 24 Lifestyle
programme.desc: En este episodio, conversamos con el Dr. Carazo, especialista en cirugía estética y reconstructiva, sobre los principios, responsabilidades y decisiones que acompañan a una intervención quirúrgica con fines estéticos. Lejos de las promesas rápidas y superficiales, el doctor nos ofrece una mirada crítica y profesional sobre lo que significa transformar el cuerpo desde una visión ética, segura y profundamente humana. Este episodio es una guía clara y honesta para quienes consideran una intervención estética, y una reflexión profunda sobre el cuerpo, la imagen y la responsabilidad médica.

programme.title: Yingge Dance: A Celebration of Heroes
programme.desc: The Yingge Dance always brings a festive energy to the Lunar New Year in southern China’s Chaoshan area, capturing the nation's attention in the process. With every strike of their mallets, a deep sense of nostalgia and cultural pride reverberates through China's youth. This episode follows animator Zhu Xiaopeng as he trains with inheritor He Murong, using modern technology to keep the spirit of Yingge alive.
